title: Normalized cokernel comparison after applying a functor and changing coordinates
statement:
Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian], and let $H:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be a functor preserving zero morphisms. Let $f:A\to B$ be a morphism in $\mathcal A$, and assume that $H$ preserves its cokernel, meaning that the image of a cokernel projection $q_f:B\to\operatorname{coker}(f)$, together with its universal property, is a cokernel of $H(f)$. Choose objects $A',B'\in\mathcal B$ and isomorphisms $a:H(A)\xrightarrow{\sim}A'$ and $b:H(B)\xrightarrow{\sim}B'$. Set $g=b\circ H(f)\circ a^{-1}:A'\to B'$, and write $q_g:B'\to\operatorname{coker}(g)$ for a cokernel projection. There is a unique isomorphism
$$u:H(\operatorname{coker}(f))\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{coker}(g),\qquad u\circ H(q_f)=q_g\circ b.$$
Its inverse satisfies $u^{-1}\circ q_g=H(q_f)\circ b^{-1}$.

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: compose CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesCokernel.iso H f (line 263 of this file) with CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel.mapIso (H.map f) g a b (by simp) (Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Limits/Shapes/Kernels.lean:899–904). The forward normalization is PreservesCokernel.π_iso_hom (Preserves/Shapes/Kernels.lean:268) followed by cokernel.mapIso_hom and cokernel.π_desc (Shapes/Kernels.lean:817), using the definition cokernel.map at lines 847–853. The inverse equation follows by composing this normalization with u.inv and b.inv; uniqueness follows because H(q_f) is a cokernel projection, hence epi. This uses no preservation of all colimits and no finite-free hypothesis.
